title: Tegno Font
author: putracetol
description: Click here and download the Tegno font · Window, Mac, Linux · Last updated 2026 · Commercial licence included ✓
fullDescription:
Step into the retro-futuristic world of Tegno, a bold Y2K font that captures the spirit of early 2000s digital culture. Designed with a techno-sci-fi aesthetic, this font boasts thick, blocky letterforms with stylized bevels and unexpected curves that give off a nostalgic yet futuristic vibe. The sharp edges and exaggerated terminals provide a cybernetic rhythm that feels right at home in digital realms, glitch art, rave flyers, and space-age branding. From bold display use to album artwork, Tegno delivers a striking visual identity that channels vaporwave flair, arcade nostalgia, and the bold irreverence of turn-of-the-millennium aesthetics.

The font’s color presentation in vibrant mint green and electric pink over a deep royal blue background reinforces its Y2K essence—evoking memories of early internet graphics and sci-fi packaging. Complete with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and a robust set of symbols and punctuation, Tegno is optimized for both print and digital media. Ideal for tech startups, music labels, fashion packaging, or anything craving a burst of retro-futurism, this font is your gateway to creating visuals that feel both nostalgic and next-gen.
ogTitle: Tegno Font by putracetol · Creative Fabrica

title: Caples Font
author: Drizy Studio
description: Click here and download the Caples font · Window, Mac, Linux · Last updated 2026 · Commercial licence included ✓
fullDescription:
Dive headfirst into the digital age with Caples, a bold, high-contrast display font that perfectly captures the nostalgic, liquid essence of the Y2K aesthetic and modern street style.

Caples is a Y2K high-contrast display font that brings back the glossy, futuristic drama of early 2000s design. Its bold curves, razor-sharp edges, and playful proportions give your lettering that iconic tech-girly vibe that defined the era. Perfect for posters, branding, logos, album covers, stickers, and anything that deserves a nostalgic punch.

This unique typeface stands out with its exceptionally rounded, chunky forms and deep, dramatic contrast in stroke thickness—noticeable in the subtle thins against the massive, bubble-like bolds, which create a captivating visual tension. Its low x-height and close-knit letterforms give it a compact, groovy, and unapologetically retro-futuristic feel.

Featuring 212 unique glyphs, Caples is designed to be a centerpiece, making it ideal for music album covers, video game branding, edgy fashion editorials, experimental poster design, and bold social media graphics that demand attention.

Use it to instantly evoke the era of chunky tech, early internet graphics, and a vibe that is simultaneously playful, vintage, and high-energy.
ogTitle: Caples Font by Drizy Studio · Creative Fabrica
